newsitem.title: USA: Interdigital says $43 mln contract lapses.
newsitem.headline: Interdigital says $43 mln contract lapses.

text.p: InterDigital Communications Corp said Monday its $43 million wireless contract with Pakistan Telecommunications Co Ltd has lapsed.

The company said Pakistan Telecommunications allowed the contract to lapse when it rejected InterDigital's proposal to finance the order for UltraPhone Time Division Multiple Access digital wireless local loop systems.
The contract had been awarded in September 1996 and was contingent on financing, which InterDigital said it had expected to be provided by the Import-Export Bank of the United States.
In November, however, the Import-Export Bank opted not to finance the order because of a high degree of economic instability in Pakistan, InterDigital said.
The company proposed alternate financing arrangements, all of which Pakistan Telecommunications rejected, it said.
